_meta.stage: PCA Stage-3 A/C pairing v1 (6 pairs)
_meta.rule: pairing basis = shared analysis goal; same goal does NOT imply equal difficulty — every pair carries the four-part difficulty cross-check; explicit-constraint coverage is a separate stratification variable, never merged into difficulty
_meta.note_P06: structure-based pairing with disclosed domain difference (owner round-13: pairing must have sufficient shared goal + difficulty basis — P06 pairs modelling-chain structure; flagged for owner attention in joint review)

pairs.shared_goal: Forest-cover quantification over defined zones (pixel-fraction SMA vs polygon zonal statistics)
pairs.pairing_basis: same analytical objective: quantify forest cover within spatial units; formulations differ (per-pixel fractions+thresholds vs raster-in-polygon percentages) — exactly the formulation effect the pair is designed to expose

parameter_constraints.note: A slightly more constrained — recorded, not hidden

output_requirements.note: A heavier on presentation; presentation scored separately

explicit_constraint_coverage.stratification_use: SEPARATE variable — never merged into difficulty score

pairs.difficulty_judgment: broadly comparable analytical depth; A carries more presentation obligations and tighter numeric constraints — differences attributed to formulation, analyzed via the coverage variable

pairs.shared_goal: Environmental time-series summarization into structured statistical outputs (monthly means grouped into reported units)
pairs.pairing_basis: same objective family: extract temporal statistics over spatial units and deliver a tabular series; A is point/polygon chart form, C is region-season long table

required_steps.A: month loop -> polygon mean + 2 point series -> charts + export
required_steps.C: season grouping -> regional means -> long table

pairs.difficulty_judgment: comparable; A's export-weighting is the main asymmetry — presentation counted separately

pairs.shared_goal: Point-to-raster extraction producing per-point/tabular values for downstream use
pairs.pairing_basis: same objective: combine point observations with gridded layers into point-keyed value sets (A: per-station monthly climate means; C: per-point multi-raster sample table)

required_steps.A: station join -> monthly grouping -> 20-year aggregation -> export

parameter_constraints.A: date range + aggregation target stated (year-count ambiguity recorded)

pairs.difficulty_judgment: A marginally heavier by the aggregation stage; acceptable within-pair delta, disclosed

pairs.shared_goal: Categorical surface mapping reduced to per-unit composition/quality reporting
pairs.pairing_basis: same objective family: classified surfaces summarized per spatial unit (A: benthic classes with accuracy; C: land-cover shares with dominance/diversity)
pairs.difficulty_judgment: comparable; A's named-method constraints are formulation, not depth

pairs.shared_goal: Multi-class surface-state analysis across time (classified states and their temporal structure)
pairs.pairing_basis: same objective family: categorical surface analysis with a temporal dimension (A: 4-class classification with pre/post-2019 validation; C: two-epoch change layer with gain/loss per class)
pairs.difficulty_judgment: comparable; both demand a temporal structure (validation split vs change direction) as the analytical core

pairs.shared_goal: Multi-stage environmental modelling chains from terrain/point inputs to classified screening outputs
pairs.pairing_basis: structurally同构 multi-step chains (interpolate/model -> combine covariates/rules -> classified screen -> validation/summary); goal domains differ (permafrost ALT vs flood exposure) — pairing justified by modelling-chain structure and stage count, with the domain difference disclosed

required_steps.A: kriging -> covariate stack -> RF -> classify -> metrics
required_steps.C: conditioning -> accumulation -> sink/flat -> rule screen -> class summary

branching_looping.note: C slightly heavier on conditional logic — recorded

pairs.difficulty_judgment: comparable depth with a disclosed domain difference; C marginally heavier on conditional logic
